notes: Shopify storefront (robots.txt allows crawling, no Claude-specific disallow; UCP/MCP catalog endpoint offered but not needed). Access route: direct fetch of nav menu, then /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 for exact enumeration on each candidate collection (Shopify products_count meta was NOT used anywhere per Rule 1). Nicobar's Home line is apparel/textile-heavy as expected; excluded entirely: All Clothing/Women/Men/Accessories/Jewellery, Bedding, Table Linens, Rugs & Curtains, Furniture, Bar Furniture, Bar Tools, Flatware (cutlery), Kitchen Essentials (spice box/ghee pot/lota-churner/roti box/parchment paper/food covers - cookware & food-storage, not tableware), Cushion Covers, all Rakhi/Godavari/Bestsellers/New Arrivals/Nico Core/Collections roll-up pages, and 'Candles & Fragrances' (reed diffusers, oil vials, incense, room sprays, scented Jar/Pillar candles). 'Gift Set'-titled SKUs were dropped as Holiday & Gift across every collection (mugs-kulhars had 26, glasses had 6, photo-frame had 4, online-exclusive-dinner-sets had 2, tea-coffee-pots had 1, carafe had 1). The nav's 'Votives & Candle Holders' and 'Candles & Fragrances' links both point to the same mixed collection (/collections/all-candles-fragrances, 101 products); used the site's own cleaner-titled duplicate collection /collections/candles-holders (35 products, same underlying catalog) and manually enumerated titles, keeping only genuine unscented candle holders/lanterns/votives/diya (28) and dropping 6 scented candles + 1 gift set (mixed roll-up, dropped not padded per Rule). RULE 0 GAIN: Mirrors is not in the main nav at all, but a live, working /collections/mirrors page exists (3 products: Suesgad, Pondicherry, Lotus) and is independently corroborated by the site's own tag-collection page /collections/all/Filterclass_Mirror which explicitly renders '3 Items' - confirmed via two independent site-reported sources. Site search also surfaced 4 older mirror product pages (Kingfisher, Palm, Periyar, Twilight Desk Mirror) that are still reachable (HTTP 200) but are NOT part of any live collection or the Filterclass_Mirror tag count (all flagged available:false in the search API) - treated as retired/delisted stock per Rule 3, not counted. Checked for a genuine Lighting category (scope requires every fixture type): no dedicated lighting collection or working tag exists (Filterclass_Lamp/Filterclass_Lighting tags 404 to the full 2329-item catalog); the 'Lighting & Decor' nav-adjacent collection (lighting-decor, found only via raw collections list, not in visible nav) contains zero lamps - only vases/bookends/gift sets mislabeled under that title; one legacy 'Dune Marble Lamp' (genuine electric lamp with bulb/wire) surfaces only via site search, is tagged under Votives & Candle Holders (not any lamp/lighting tag) and is not part of any live collection - concluded Nicobar currently sells no Lighting fixture line, so no Lighting row is emitted (absence, not a miss). Duplicate-company check: no master company-list reference file was present in this worker's scratchpad to cross-check SR 313 against other SR numbers; brand name 'Nicobar' and domain nicobar.com are singular/unambiguous with no other Nicobar entity found during this extraction.
